title: Petition of NSTAR Electric Company for an exemption from the Zoning By-laws of the Towns of Carver and Wareham, pursuant to G.L. c. 40A, § 3. for the proposed expansion of the Company's electric substation in Carver, Massachusetts, and an expanded control house at the Company's Tremont Station in Wareham, Massachusetts.
filings: DPU Chairman consolidates DPU 07-60 and DPU 07-61
Order of Notice and Notice of Filing and Public Hearing issued by DPU
Counsel for NSTAR files pre-filed testimony of John M. Zicko, P.E., Gregory Sullivan, James Bodkin and Colin Duncan
Presiding Officer requests company to provide a more detailed map of the transmission line route
Counsel for NSTAR files Motion for Protective Treatment of Confidential Information
Counsel for NSTAR files zoning exemption checklist
NSTAR Electric Company files petition for an exemption from the zoning by-laws of Carver and Wareham pursuant to G.L. c. 40A, § 3
